A black-and-white clean professional concept art sheet shows three vermine creatures with very different body shapes and silhouettes. Each is drawn with detailed linework and tonal shading. All share multiple large eyes, proboscis, and hunched digitigrade posture, but with highly varied leg anatomy. Each character is clearly labeled with its name. These are the only labels.

The Tide-Merchant (left) – Appears broad and heavy due to multiple layers of flowing robes with maritime patterns. Deep hood hides most their face, only a short proboscis emerges. Thick digitigrade legs visible below robes. Hands emerging from sleeves with extremely long claws, one of them holds a purse and the other touches their proboscis.

The Wall-Keeper (center) – Tall, wrapped in countless fabric layers making them seem massive and shapeless. A large hat covers his face and cast a shadow on his frame, as only a long proboscis emerges. Long spindly legs barely visible. He holds a large set of keys in his claws from voluminous sleeve.

The Cave-Runner (right) – Standing alert as if ready to run, small frame, wearing minimal torn vest exposing thin hunched anatomy. Elongated head, multiple huge reflective eyes, impossibly long proboscis hanging down to their waist, round features. Extremely long legs show extreme digitigrade bend with elongated foot bones. Pale fur visible on exposed limbs, with two tails.

The sheet includes head side views, and items and fabric draping focus. They all appear mysterious and somehow cute. White paper background. Draw inspiration from the given images.

A black-and-white clean professional concept art sheet shows three vermine creatures with distinct morphologies and clothing styles. Each is drawn with detailed linework and tonal shading. All share multiple large eyes, proboscis, and hunched digitigrade posture, but with highly varied anatomations. Each character is clearly labeled with its name. These are the only labels.

The Storm-Watcher (left) – Tall lean silhouette under tattered weather cloak flapping in wind. Hood frames gaunt angular face with small clustered eyes and thick muscular proboscis curled upward with tusks. Strong reverse-jointed legs with massive clawed feet gripping the ground. One hand shields eyes from imagined wind. Meteorological instruments hangs at his belt. Parallel scars across exposed chest. Spiral motives on fur.

The Depth-Sage (center) – Appears enormous and rotund under layered academic robes covered in carved symbols. Face completely hidden in shadow under wide hood, only serpentine proboscis as thick as an arm emerging and coiling. Just one skeletal hand visible holding ancient tablets, wearing multiple rings. Impossible to guess true body size beneath. Mysterious imposing presence.

The Outcast (right) – Crouched defensive posture, medium frame in ragged patched clothes. Wildly asymmetric face with three eyes of different sizes, bent broken proboscis, many scars. One leg shorter than the other creating limping stance. Patchy fur, a big curved horn emerging from skull. Arms crossed protectively. Zebra fur.

The sheet includes head side views, close-ups, items and draping focus. They all appear mysterious and somehow cute. White paper background. Draw inspiration from the given images.

A black-and-white clean professional concept art sheet shows three vermine creatures from different social contexts. Each is drawn with detailed linework and tonal shading. All share multiple large eyes, proboscis, and hunched digitigrade posture, but with highly varied anatomations. Each character is clearly labeled with its name. These are the only labels.

The Negotiator (left) – Draped in ornate flowing robes making them appear bulky and round. Small delicate face visible under decorated hood—six tiny gentle eyes arranged in spiral, elegant curved proboscis with pierced rings. Thin graceful arms making elaborate hand gestures with impossibly long delicate fingers. Heavy silk-like fabric contrasts with visible refined features. Floral patterns on exposed fur patches.

The Scavenger (center) – Compact muscular body under patchwork hooded cloak made of mismatched fabrics. Two pairs of intense eyes, a short aggressive proboscis with notched scars emerges from his scarf. Powerful thick legs crouched low ready to pounce. Holds salvaged blade in clawed hand, other hand flat on ground. Alert dangerous posture. Battle scars across visible limbs.

The Incubator-Priest (right) – Completely obscured by ceremonial white fabrics creating massive ghostly flowing form. Large ornate hat towers above casting deep shadow. Only lower portion of serene face visible—calm half-closed eyes, elegant proboscis hanging straight down with ritual paint marks. Extremely long backward-bent legs extend from robes like stilts. One hand raised in blessing gesture barely visible through fabric layers. Geometric symbols embroidered on robes.

The sheet includes head side views, close-ups, items and draping focus. They all appear mysterious and somehow cute. White paper background. Draw inspiration from the given images.
